nom: Neutrogena Collagen Bank Vitamin C Face Serum Fragrance Free

avis.texte: Super clean, super potent, and super natural‑smelling. Although it works, for me personally the scent gave me the ick every time I put it on my face. If you can ignore the smell, it's actually a great product.

This serum really works and does what it says. I have 50+ skin and it has made a difference. My skin is smoother, more even toned and younger looking and feeling. I dont want them to change anything. If they change the smell, im worried it will change the product, so please dont! The benefits outweigh the temporary smell!
Love this stuff. those of you complAining about the smell… its fragrance free if they added one it WOULDN'T be good for SENSITIVE skin…
Just start usig this and while i love the way it makes my skin feel, it smells terribly

avis.titre: mY SKIN HAD BAD REACTION TO SERUM.
avis.texte: developed BAD SENSITIVITY FROM VITAMIN C I SUPPOSE AND I DO NOT HAVE OVERLY SENSITIVE SKIN. ALL OF MY OTHER PRODUCTS I USED DAILY FOR YEARS STARTED TO BURN MY SKIN AFTER I USED C SERUM AT THE END OF THE DAY (ALSO I WEAR SUNSCREEN RELIGIOUSLY) SO I HAD TO STOP. i STILL LOVE AND USE MOISTURIZER.
This is a great dupe for the SR serum! Its got a strong smell like a fruity Pinot Grigio and I'm here for it! Definitely heavier than other Vit C serums, but my skin loves it and soaks it right up!

I have been using Neutrogena Vit. C for a month (along with Collagen Bank sunscreen) and it has made a noticeable difference in my skin's texture, and is fading my hyperpigmentation. I'm 54 years old; would definitely recommend for my age group.

I bought this off of Dr. Dray's (Dermatologist on YouTube) recommendation. I do not care for this serum at all - it smells disgusting and it has an oily texture, very slippery on the skin. I am giving it 3 stars because it did not irritate my skin at all - it's just personal preference with the texture and horrible smell. I much prefer Timeless Vitamin C serum and will go back to using that.

I have nothing but good things to say about this product. It doesn't burn or irritate my skin like a lot of vitamin C does. It doesn't leave residue or grit on skin like other vitamin C does. I notice a brightness when I use it consistently.

I am on chemotherapy and having lots of skin issues. Santa put this in my stocking. It seems to really be helping with the loss of firmness in my skin. It's great to find something that makes this journey a little better.

avis.titre: Perfect for sensitive skin and budget friendly
avis.texte: Just turned 50 and after trying so many expensive/ "top notch" serums, this one definitely has been the best for my sensitive skin and the price is budget friendly!

avis.titre: Really good serum just two changes needed!
avis.texte: THis is an excellent vitamin c serum the only two changes Neutrogena should make is put this in an airless pump as vitamin c can oxidize in the air and two, it does smell like hot dog water but the smell does not linger for too long. Overall this is a really good serum just make these two changes and if you can't get rid of the smell, at least put it in an airless pump bottle.

I guess this is too strong for my skin. My face started slightly burning about 5 minutes after application and continued until I rinsed my face to get the produt off. I use a 5% benzoyl peroxide cream for acne control so that might have contributed to it, but I need to be able to use products together. I ended up returning.

I just bought this yesterday and when i used it today and put it on my face, i was immediately hit with a disgusting smell. I'm not sure if its supposed to smell like that or if the product has gone bad but its enough to turn me off from using it again.

i'm not sure of this product's theraputic benefits because i can't get past the smell. i'm wondering if the collagen is 'bovine' because this smells so meaty. maybe i got a bad batch but i'm afraid i'll smell like steak tartar - and not in a good way!!!
This product was just ok. I didn't see a lot of change in my skin during the time I was using it. The scent is peculiar as I get an orange smell but also chemical smell.

Overall this is a pretty good serum! I do like the consistency and how it soaks into my skin. My skin does look a little clearer, but it's too early to tell how much of a significant difference it might make.

I tried the Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum for two weeks and I already see the effects of it! My skin tone is more even and looks brighter after everyday use, and the results show faster than when I used other vit c products. I did not have any irritation but my skin is used to high concentrations

Thank you Home Tester Club for sending this product in exchange for an honest review. The Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum is a well-formulated skincare product that delivers noticeable results. Its packaging is consistent with the clean, clinical aesthetic of other Neutrogena products—simple, effective, and to the point. The applicator is easy to use, allowing for precise and hygienic application. I appreciate that the serum is fragrance-free, which is ideal for those sensitive to scents or who prefer a more neutral skincare experience. The product glides smoothly over the skin and absorbs well, leaving a hydrated and refreshed feeling. After consistent use, I noticed my complexion appeared brighter and more revitalized. My skin genuinely looked more alive and healthy. Overall, this is a product I would confidently recommend to anyone seeking to enhance their skincare routine with a reliable Vitamin C serum.

Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C is a lightweight, fast-absorbing serum that brightens the skin and helps improve overall texture. It gives a healthy glow, reduces dullness, and feels gentle without irritation, making it a solid choice for daily use

I was extremely impressed with this serum! It has great hydrating properties, is easy to apply, and I have been getting compliments multiple times throughout the last month that I have been using it. It is not irritating at all and is a great complement to the rest of my skin care regimen which usually includes a SPF moisturizer immediately after the serum.
great product! love that this smooth moisturizer has SPF built in. invisible application and works well. very lightweight with good protection

avis.titre: Doesn't play well with other products
avis.texte: While it may be effective due to the high potency, this serum didn't agree with me. I found the smell to be overwhelming and the serum didn't play well with other products I used it with, even others in the Collagen Bank line by Neutrogena. When combining products, I experienced pilling, which meant I couldn't do my whole skincare routine and add SPF like I prefer to.

I wasn't super impressed with this product. It felt like the "brightness" of the product was just a gold tint to the serum. My skin broke out after using this and I didn't feel like it changed my skin much.

Love this product, leaves my skin so refreshed moisturized and ready for any other skincare routine. Love that it is easy to apply and not oily, dries quickly and you can tell them difference. Definitely recommend

I did not use this product for the full term of the trial as I got a bad breakout from it. I haven't had issues with collagen or vitamin c products before so I would assume this is likely a formula issue. Bummed because this sounded like a great option.
I absolutely love this product. My skin has never felt so smooth and plump. The product is not sticky in any way and it goes on nice and smooth. It was easy to add to my everyday routine.

This Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum is SO good! I love the way it feels on my skin and that after several weeks of using, my skin looks and feels better, too. I also appreciate that for Vitamin C, unlike some other brands, this one isn't in a glass bottle. Makes it easier to keep longer - since Vitamin C needs to be stored differently.

Loved the vitamin C. Did not irritate my skin. Went on smoothly and mixed with my moisturizer. My skin seemed to react really well to the product. No dryness or itchiness. Made my skin look brighter and overall very happy with it.

avis.titre: A really good vitamin c serum!
avis.texte: Neutrogena really did something with this vitamin c serum! The way it makes my skin glow is so amazing. My dermatologist told me to use vitamin c serum at night and spf in the mornings, so that's exactly what I did. I noticed my skin feels and looks more plump and hydrated right after use and especially in the morning. I've also noticed my skin tone has been balancing out. It is definitely worth the money if you're in the need of a really good vitamin c serum.

The Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum brightens and evens out skin tone with its 15% Vitamin C formula. It absorbs quickly, leaving skin soft and hydrated, with a noticeable glow. Great for boosting radiance

avis.titre: Best serum I've been able to stick with.
avis.texte: This is the first serum of any kind that I have actually seen results with. My skin can be sensitive to actives , especially retinols, many times causing me to discontinue use. I experienced no irritation with this and the bonus was seeing and feeling result within a week. Smoother brighter and plumper skin with less texture. I've also noticed improved moisture balance and less oil breakthrough. Even my makeup looks better while the improvement in my skin texture has me using less base product. I've found using a milky toner, then the C serum, followed by a peptide moisturizer tolock everything in both morning and night is perfectly agreeing with my skin. I am 54 with combination skin.
This face serum was great. It helped even my skin tone and made my skin feel nice and hydrated. I do think my skin overall feels better.

avis.titre: Neutrogena Collagen Bank Vitamin C Serum
avis.texte: The Neutrogena Collagen Bank Vitamin C Serum has been a nice addition to my skincare routine. The serum is pretty lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky, which makes it easy to layer under moisturizer or makeup. I noticed my skin looked a bit brighter and smoother after consistent use. It hasn't caused me any irritation which can sometimes happen with vitamin C products. I also like that the packaging keeps the serum protected so it stays more potent. Something I would like to see improved is the strength of the brightening results. It works gradually, so if you're looking for fast or dramatic changes, this may not be as strong as some higher-concentration serums. One thing I didn't care for was the scent. I know that vitamin C serums can sometimes have less than appealing scents and while this one is much more subtle it's not my favorite. It thankfully dries down quickly enough and doesn't linger.

I enjoyed the overall coverage and consistency of the product. I did not enjoy how it dried my skin out. I naturally have oily skin, and when using this product I made sure to moisturize and use SPF. Still made my skin tight and dry & makeup didn't blend well with it unfortunately.

I've used this serum for the last few weeks and unfortunately I haven't really seen any improvement for better or worse. I appreciate that it didn't have an obnoxious scent and the texture of the serum itself was good. I'll probably finish using the bottle but there was no noticeable difference. I have used other vitamin C serums in the past andi was able to see changes about two weeks in.

I noticed a difference in the brightness of my skin. However, this product contains enough vitamin c to where people with sensitive skin should be careful. This product broke me out, so just be mindful of the high percentage of vitamin c. If your skin can tolerate it then it's a great product. Just not for me.

I've been using this Vitamin C serum for over 4 weeks, and the effects are noticeable. The lightweight, fast-absorbing texture layers beautifully under SPF and makeup (SPF is a must!), without stickiness. I've already noticed a subtle glow and more even tone. The added micro-peptides lend a reassuring sense of firmness, though the improvements aren't dramatic just yet in this field. As a regular vitamin C user, my only hesitation is the modest bottle size, meaning it's easy to run through quickly.

I feel in love with this collagen bank vitamin c serum. It makes my skin tone more even and moisturized. It pairs perfectly with the Collagen Bank Moisturizer from neutrogena really has my skin glowing. This is definitely getting added to my skincare routine.

The vitamin C serum Glides pretty well onto your skin and absorbs pretty quickly. I'm not sure I see any difference yet but so far it hasn't done any harm and I like how it absorbs into the skin pretty quickly and it doesn't make you oily or anything.

I love this serum! It is so lightweight, it layers nicely and doesn't pill when I wear it with SPF. As a long term vitamin c user, I find it to be non-irritating and I've noticed a really fast difference in my skin - people keep telling me I look more glowy. This will definitely become a staple in my morning skincare routine.
Overall, I enjoyed this vitamin c serum. It was a little stickier than I would have liked but it worked well with my other skincare and wasn't super thick.

avis.titre: Glowy Skin but Smells like Beef Broth
avis.texte: The Neutrogena Vitamin C Serum worked wonders on my skin. After using it for 4 weeks, I notice my face is brighter and plumper. My skin tone is lot more even, I have less dry patches because my skin looks are lot more hydrated. It absorbed well and quick into my skin, which made my morning routine a lot easier to work with, because I like to go straight to my moisturizer and sunscreen after the Vit C serum. However, one thing I have to mention is this serum has an overwhelming smell of beef broth. I'm assuming it's from the collagen, but I've never had a collagen skincare product that gives off such a meat smell like this (I've definitely eaten collagen jelly that tasted like broth). Luckily, I use a moisturizer right after the serum, and the moisturizer is fragranced, to cover use the brothy smell. But because of the smell, I'm not sure if I would go back to this Neutrogena Vitamin C serum, when there are other vitamin C serums out there that works well and doesn't smell like broth.

this serum spreads easily and goes on in a nice, thin layer. it doesn't feel sticky and it absorbs in quickly. a small amount goes a long way, and it doesn't leave me feeling greasy. i think my skin looks smoother overall since using it for the past few weeks. i would recommend trying it.

avis.titre: A Very Nice Vitamin C Serum
avis.texte: I recently was able to test Neutrogina Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum. I've been using this for a month and can honestly say I'm on the fence about it. I like that it is Fragrance Free, Dye Free, Non-Comedogentic, and Paraben Free. It's also Allergy-Tested. My first step is to wash my face thoroughly and let it completely dry, then apply this serum. What I don't like about this is it goes on very sticky! It also takes time for it to absorb. After applying my regular moisturizer, it still feels sticky. I haven't really noticed that much of a difference in the appearance of my skin, but it does feel softer. I will continue to use the rest of this, and hopefully, my opinion will change. I love all of Neutrogina's products, so I'm very optimistic about using this and seeing positive results. I was gifted Neutrogina Collagen Bank 15% Pure Vitamin C Serum complimentary for my honest opinion.

The smell is awful let's get that out of the way. Genuinely an awful smell BUT it works amazing. It shows a difference and the smell does disappear once you rub it in your skin. This product I received for free in exchange for my honest review.

I found the Neutrogena Collagen Bank Vitamin C Serum very hydrating. It is very thick and sits heavy on the skin. It does take a while to fully absorb into your skin. However it does do its job. My skin was soft and smooth and the lines were less noticeable. I made this the last step of my facial routine before applying makeup, it did need several minutes to absorb before applying makeup. It is very much worth the few minutes wait for smoother and brighter skin.

I have liked using the Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C serum and notice my face looking brighter, the skin tighter and overall better since beginning. It goes on and absorbs nicely, it isn't sticky. I still continue using for sure.

I used the Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum for a month and noticed my skin looked brighter and more refreshed. The formula feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers well under moisturizer without feeling greasy. However, I did notice the cap turning yellow over time, which makes me wonder if the product oxidizes easily. Overall, it delivers visible brightening results, but the packaging could be improved to better preserve its potency.

I had to come on here and talk about this Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum because whew my skin is LIVING. I've been using it for a few weeks now and babyyyy, the glow is real. Like, fresh-faced, no-makeup selfie real. It goes on super smooth, soaks in quick, and doesn't leave me feeling greasy or sticky. I love how lightweight it is but still feels like it's actually doing something. My dark spots from old breakouts? Already looking lighter. My skin just looks brighter, healthier, and more even. And can we talk about the collagen boost? Yes please! My skin feels a little firmer and just… happier. If you've been on the hunt for a good vitamin C serum that shows up and shows out, sis—this is the one. Neutrogena really did something here!

The Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum is nice addition to daily morning skincare routine. The product went on smoothly and there was no unpleasant smell. After a few weeks usage there was a small difference in clarity and overall appearance of my skin.

avis.titre: Quality Serum at a Reasonable Price
avis.texte: I thought that the serum absorbed nicely, but not as quickly as some of my other serums. There was no unpleasant scent or greasy texture and my skin had no adverse reactions. My skin looks healthier so I am pleased with the serum.

This product is amazing. Gave my skin an instant glow without being sticky or feeling like there was a film or greasiness on my skin. The 15% vitamin C concentration gave my skin an instant glow, and after about a week of consistent use, I started noticing improved texture and firmness, especially around my cheeks and under my eyes. I really like it!

Received this free from HomeTesterClub in exchange for my honest opinion and review-Not good for me. It irritated and broke my skin out almost immediately. It smelled so sour, like inside of a tin can and old musty dust. It was tacky on the skin as well. I reported this and was asked to discontinue use. So I did. Maybe it's good for others?!
This is the best vitamin c serum i have used so far. My skin is dry and it works great for my skin. Seeing difference in my skin after using it.

This product is interesting. At first it actually smelled quite strong (not in a good way). Perhaps that's the collagen? Then the smell subsided after a few days (but that's also when I got a head cold, so maybe that's why I didn't smell it any more). My product did not last the full four weeks. I used it up about 1.5 weeks early. I had been using a full squeeze every morning and night. I used it on my neck too (from that one squeeze.) it felt very silky and might have helped with some fine lines. Wish it had lasted the full four weeks!

My absolute best liquid face oil that I started using and I have a great results that my face is glowing and have evened my skin tone with the time. It's targeted to treat and to fill your skin with the collagen, at first few weeks you won't see much difference, but the ritual by using it you would get that dreamy plumper looking skin. Followed by the instructions and use. Applicator is super easy to apply, just squeeze the golden looking oil with no scent at all to the face areas that need attention and massage it, would absorb instantly. No sticky or oily feeling afterwards, soaks right in and you just wait and see. It's affordable comparing to other products nowadays and the benefits that Neutrogena brings to your daily skin care is impressive. Love it and would recommend to others.

I used this product one to two times a day for a month. I have used vitamin c serums in the past and this was not my favorite. I did not notice that big of a difference compared to high end brands. I will continue using this until I run out so hopefully I see a bigger difference with more time. I would not purchase again.
I think it was helpful but my worst wrinkles are on forehead and around my eyes. This is definitely not good for use around the eyes and when you sweat, even hours later, it burns your eyes.

I received Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum in exchange of my honest opinion. It comes with a dropper dispenser, just a few drops are enough for your entire face. The product has good spreadability and works well. I didn't see any noteworthy changes on my skin in 4 weeks. One major con for me was the smell. It smells of fish for the first few seconds you apply it which later fades away.

I have been using the Neutrogena Vitamin C serum every night after cleansing and I've been loving it. The patented micro-peptide technology works to improve collagen levels while evening out your skin tone. But be sure to use it with SPF!

Overall this product was nice, but I'm not exactly sure how effective is was after using continuously for the last couple weeks. The serum itself was nice quality. It melted into my skin pretty quickly without a stickiness or film that some serums do. There wasn't a smell and it wasn't too oily. Not sure if it would make it into my daily routine after this bottle, but I will continue to use and see if I notice any results.

avis.titre: Lightweight and effective but smells off
avis.texte: I was gifted Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C serum in exchange for my honest review. I tested it for 4 weeks and thought it was a good serum. It goes on smoothly and feels lightweight, but still gives my skin a nice glow. I've noticed my skin looks a little brighter and more even in the mornings. It doesn't feel sticky and layers well with my other products. I am not a huge fan of the scent. It is citrusy, but smells old, as if I got an older batch of the serum. I'm big on scent so likely would not purchase this on my own.

I'm grateful to have been sent this Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum for free in exchange for my review. I think it did a good job of plumping my skin and making my skin tone look more even than before.

This product felt like a very strong vitamin C serum. I will say that actually irritated my skin a little bit, so I stopped using this midway through the trial. However, I thought the quality was clearly there.
Great value good price. Have been using for the last 4 weeks. Noticeable smaller less visible pores and brighter skin. Works best paired with the moisturizer. Droplet could be improved to not be weak

I like that this serum absorbs quickly into the skin and does not cause breakouts even though the texture of the serum is oily. I noticed that it has brightened my skin with regular use. The serum has no fragrance to it but for the lack of better word `the no fragrance` smell is not for me. It reminds me of hospital/medicine smell. I would have preferred having it smell like nothing.

I've been using the Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum for a few weeks now and I'm impressed. It goes on super smooth, absorbs quickly, and doesn't feel sticky or heavy. My skin looks noticeably brighter and more even, and I love that it's fragrance-free and non-comedogenic great for my sensitive skin. The formula has 15% pure vitamin C, plus peptides and PHA, which gives my skin a nice glow without irritation. I didn't expect overnight miracles, but I've definitely seen improvement in tone and texture. It plays well under makeup and hasn't caused any breakouts. This is a great option if you want a high-strength vitamin C serum that's effective, clean, and affordable. I'll definitely repurchase.

I wasn't really impressed. I know this is a great brand so I hoped to see great results but that just wasn't the case. I use it every night along with a moisturizer and haven't seen much result. Also if you start to sweat even the smallest amount your face gets super slimy.

First I love how easily this spreads, you can use a little less and it goes a long way. I love the scent, you can smell the vitamin c. I did notice my face appearing more glowing and softer on the days I use it. It penetrates the skin well and soaks in. Overall I think it's a wonderful serum/oil and I will be keeping in my skincare routine. I am able to apply it to my face and let it set for a minute or two and then add my other products. I have never had any product pilling.

I love the idea of combining collegen and vitamin C. With consistent use my skin has better tone and texture. It did nothing to help my acne but my skin looked overall much better. Not a sticky feeling after using like other vitamin c products I have used.

avis.titre: Effective serum from a trusted brand
avis.texte: I was sent the Neutrogena Vitamin C serum to try for free in exchange for my honest opinion. My favorite thing about this product was how it instantly hydrated and smoothed my facial skin. While I didn't notice any significant difference in skin "brightness" or radiance, the product was pleasant and easy to use, and I didn't notice any adverse effects.
Its consistency is like a light oily feel that is quickly absorbed. My skin instantly felt hydrated and even had a glow. Huge plus can be worn under makeup.
I've been trying this out for a few weeks now. This is the first Vitamin C serum I have ever used. It hydrates my skin and makes my skin feel great but doesn't make my skin really look brighter.

Since using this Vitamin C serum consistently for over a month, I've noticed amazing results. I can definitely see that my skin looks brighter and feels smoother. I love how lightweight the formula is and that it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. However, I just can't stand the smell of the product, which is why I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5. If scent doesn't bother you, this serum is absolutely worth trying because the results are fantastic.

Neutrogena's Collagen Bank with Vitamin C serum has been a great addition to my anti-aging routine. I'm 43 and am noticing the effects of aging in some ways like some dullness and discoloration, but this serum has given me my youthful glow and radiance back. It's easy to use with the dropper style bottle, absorbs well, doesn't cause breakouts and wears well with my other skincare and under makeup. Definitely recommend.
This is a great quality product. It really helps even my skin time. It doesn't irritate. Its great quality for the price. Definitely saw improvement fast

This serum exceeded my expectation's. I've tried many Vitamin C serums and this one is not sticky, is fragrance free and blends well with moisturizer. I'd recommend it to anyone looking to have supple skin or even their skin tone. I really felt like it added a glow in the morning after using it with my moisturizer.

I have really been liking this serum as a daytime option in my routine. It goes on smoothly and blends in well, smells slightly like citrus, and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. The packaging is hefty, although I wish the bottle was clear so I could see how much was inside. I think this is a solid serum that I'll likely keep using.
It's a life changing product. It feels great on your skin and doesn't make your skin feel tight. It makes your skin feel very soft and radiant.

I've been using the Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum and it truly lives up to the hype! The texture feels luxurious, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin looking brighter and more even. I noticed a real improvement in discoloration and my skin feels firmer and more hydrated. Love that it's clinically proven and packed with high-potency ingredients, definitely a new staple in my skincare routine

The Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum has been a wonderful addition to my skincare routine. I've used other Vitamin C serums in the past but this one is my favorite. My skin is dry with dark spots and this serum made my skin look radiant and healthy. I would recommend this product to anyone looking for an effective serum with vitamin C.

I really enjoyed using this product, I liked that it was moisturizing without feeling greasy. My skin felt nice and hydrated the whole time I was using it. I also like the fact that it did not have a strong smell, and it was very convenient to use the serum dropper.

I've been using this product for about a month or so, and it has helped keep my skin hydrated and glowing. Beyond that I haven't noticed much of a difference. The serum goes on smoothly and my skin drinks it up. It doesn't leave behind any residue and pairs well with my other products. I apply it every morning and wear it with SPF 50, and haven't had any issues. Overall, it's a nice addition to my routine, but not earth shattering.

I tried out this Vitamin C serum for a month, and I'm happy with the results. After I wash my face in the morning, I'd put on the serum and massage it in with my guasha. Once it dried I'd apply moisturizer and SPF. My skin is noticeably smoother and more vibrant. I love the dropper that comes with and it dispenses the perfect amount of product.

As long as you are consistent with this, it works great! It's a heavier serum but it absorbs extremely well and doesn't burn my skin like other Vitamin C serums have. It also doesn't clog my pores which I was super concerned about. I have combination skin/acne prone skin and I have definitely seen the change of texture in my skin, and it feeling more hydrated and bright. I couple it with Neutrogenas Hydro Boost Moisturizer that has SPF 25 in it and it truly melts into my skin!

Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum is hands down one of the best. I started using it to target some uneven skin tone and discoloration from past breakouts, and within just a couple of weeks, I noticed a real difference. My skin looked brighter, more even, and just had that healthy glow I've been chasing for ages. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, without leaving any sticky residue. I love that it layers well under moisturizer and makeup, so it fits right into my morning routine. And no irritation at all, which is rare for high-strength vitamin C products. If you're dealing with dullness or dark spots and want visible results, this is it. Highly recommend. My skin has never looked more even-toned!
This serum was absolutely amazing. I use it every morning and it does not affect my makeup or me using sunscreen. This Product makes my skin glow and corrects uneven surfaces of my skin!

I highly recommend Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum. After just a couple of uses, I noticed a visible improvement in my skin. My skin looked brighter and felt smoother. The serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or sticky. Its extremely easy to use and apply.
The vitamin c serum has been working great, i interpreted it into my daily skin care routine . It has helped my skin significantly with skin tone and skin damage!

I've been using the Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum for about four weeks now, and I absolutely love it. I've tried a few vitamin C serums in the past, but nothing compares to this one. I apply it daily to my face and neck after cleansing, and it goes on so smoothly. It also works beautifully as a base under makeup, which is a huge plus—especially with how hot it's been lately (we've been hitting the upper 90s here in Wisconsin!). Since using it, my skin looks more radiant and even-toned, and I've noticed a real improvement in discoloration. It gives my skin a healthy, glowing look and doesn't feel heavy or sticky. I'm genuinely impressed with the results and will definitely be repurchasing. Highly recommend!

I've been using this serum for a couple of weeks and really like how it makes my skin feel. It goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and gives my skin a nice glow. The high concentration of vitamin C helps brighten my complexion, and it doesn't irritate my skin. I like that it's fragrance-free and doesn't feel sticky. So far, it's a great addition to my routine!

I received the Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum for free. After using it for 4 weeks morning and night I noticed my dry skin improved and felt softer. My sun spots got lighter in some areas while other areas need more time for improvement. This serum is lightweight and the skin absorbs it well. It is not oily. Overall I like this product.
Its a nice serums that I use everyday and makes my skin more firm. .

avis.titre: Gets the glow back into your skin!
avis.texte: This product definitely gets what you need out of it. It gives you hydrated Skin, helps with the wrinkles and fine lines because of that, puts the glow back in your face to give you that extra youthful skin. The only negative that I would give this is that I would've loved to it have been a water base versus an oil base, but don't let that stop you. I highly recommend this product.

I've been using the Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum for over 4 weeks now, and it's quickly become a staple in my morning routine. From the first application, I noticed how lightweight and smooth the formula felt—it absorbed quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy residue, which is a huge plus for me. avis.titre: Glowy results for dry, dehydrated skin
avis.texte: I was gifted the Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum, and I've been incorporating it into my skincare routine. I apply it right after toner and before my moisturizer, just a few drops pressed into the skin and spread. For reference, I have dry, dehydrated skin that tends to soak up everything I use. My texture is mostly smooth, though I do have a bit of roughness on one cheek, along with some sun spots. This doesn't soak in. It gradually nourishes my skin. It's also fragrance free! After consistent use, I improvement in those areas! More glowy and plump skin. It's sold me on using vitamin C! For reference, I'm almost 40.
